LanguageData.WFL_Checkup_Round: {0} has begun a round of check-ups. People are asked to come when they are free.
LanguageData.WFL_Event_Checkups_Text: {0} has planned the colony's next round of check-ups for tomorrow. Anyone who needs tending is seen to first, and people are asked to come when they are free; nobody is made to. You do not need to do anything. You can begin now, put it off for a week, or skip it this time.
LanguageData.WFL_Event_Illness_Text: {0} is seeing the sick first. Anyone who needs tending is still tended before anything else.
LanguageData.WFL_Event_NoPost_Doctor: Nobody holds the post of doctor on this map.
LanguageData.WFL_Event_BeginCheckupsDesc: Have the colony's doctor begin a round of check-ups now. Anyone who needs tending is seen to first; people are asked to come, and the sick are visited where they are. In an outbreak the sick are seen first.
LanguageData.WFL_Checkup_Illness: {0} is seeing the sick first. Tending still comes before any check-up.
LanguageData.WFL_Care_NurseTitles: The community has its first Doctor. Entry-level care workers are now called Nurses.
LanguageData.WFL_Care_CounselorBonus: Supportive talks gain 10 percentage points of success chance and can encourage reconciliation.
LanguageData.WFL_Care_SurgeonBonus: Post-operation and implant follow-ups gain one quality band, capped at Excellent.
LanguageData.WFL_Care_MidwifeBonus: Pregnancy and childbirth follow-ups gain one quality band, capped at Excellent; attended births leave a positive memory.
LanguageData.WFL_Care_VeterinarianBonus: Animal examinations gain one quality band, capped at Excellent, and animal tending builds veterinary experience.
LanguageData.WFL_Care_None: Nobody is assigned to care work yet. Assign a Healer or Doctor on the Professions page.
LanguageData.WFL_Care_Capacity: Routine visits the community can give in a day: {0} (up to {1} while an outbreak round is on).
LanguageData.WFL_Care_NoSeat: No care worker holds the working seat, so no round can run.
LanguageData.WFL_Care_OutbreakRound: An outbreak round is under way: the sick are seen first.
